title: Bath Time in the Garden
setting: A sunny garden with pink flowers, a tub of water and a small brown dog.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: It is a warm June day in the garden.
sentences.zh: 六月的一天，花园里很暖和。
sentences.scene_prompt: A sunny garden in early summer with green grass, flowers and a tub of water.

sentences.en: Ben is nine, and Anna is twelve.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt stands next to the taller Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress in the garden.

sentences.en: They want to give their dog a bath.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt and Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress hold a small brown dog next to a tub of water in the garden.

sentences.en: The dog runs around the pink flowers.
sentences.zh: 小狗绕着粉红色的花跑来跑去。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small wet brown dog runs around a bed of pink flowers in the garden.

sentences.en: Anna waits for a moment until it stops.
sentences.zh: 安娜等了一会儿，直到它停下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress stands still and waits as the small brown dog slows down near the flowers.

sentences.en: Each child takes a turn with the brush.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子轮流用刷子刷。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt brushes the small brown dog in the tub while Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress waits holding another brush.

sentences.en: Then they share a banana, piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 然后他们一块一块地分吃一根香蕉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt and Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress sit on the grass sharing pieces of a banana.

sentences.en: “Help yourself to another piece,” says Ben.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy of nine with short brown hair and a blue T-shirt holds out a piece of banana to the small brown dog, and Anna, a girl of twelve with long blonde hair and a yellow dress laughs.
